The buyer, that is the distributor, bears freight. Under PP-2023 all despatches are ex-works, so freight, transit insurance and unloading are to the buyer's account irrespective of order value. DRI does not bear freight on a Rs 3,00,000 (Rs 3 lakh) order shipped in February 2024; the FOR-destination clause is the superseded PP-2019 term.
24 months from despatch (under Addendum A for pre-acquisition stock)

Three documents. The GST registration certificate (GST certificate), a cancelled cheque, and an MSME declaration where applicable. Under VOS-7 these are collected by Procurement at step 2 of the onboarding procedure, and all onboarding documents are filed in The Vault within 7 days of vendor code creation.

CFO approval is required, that is sign-off by the Chief Financial Officer, because the projected annual spend of Rs 14,00,000 (Rs 14 lakh) exceeds the Rs 10,00,000 threshold in the VOS-7 approval matrix. A direct-material vendor additionally requires Plant Head and QA clearance; all other vendors require GM Procurement.
